notes.title: 🛠️ Devlog #1: Camp System + New Video Released!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528603/18aecbd273d5f862cd035cc39850384327926a5c.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone![/p][p]The development of [i]Off Road Together[/i] is progressing at full speed, and this week, we’re excited to share a major update regarding one of the game’s core systems — [b]the camp system[/b].[/p][p]In earlier showcases, camp areas were mainly portrayed as symbolic spots for time skipping. However, based on your feedback and our own vision for the game, we've decided to transform camps into more interactive and gameplay-enhancing elements.[/p][h3]🔧 Camps Are No Longer Just Rest Stops — They’re Strategic Hubs[/h3][p]With the new system, camp areas will now allow you to:[/p][p]🛢️ Refill fuel and supplies,
🧽 Clean your vehicle and perform basic maintenance,
🧰 Manage equipment checks and repair tasks,
👥 Organize team roles and set up working groups.[/p][p]This means camps are no longer just a place to rest — they become [b]central hubs for resource management and strategic decision-making[/b].[/p][h3]🎥 New Video Out Now![/h3][p]If you’d like to get a closer look at the upcoming camp mechanics, don’t miss the brand-new gameplay video we’ve released today![/p]
